tei:div.tei:p:
Let the breath of all the living praise Thy Name, O Lord our God, and the spirit of all flesh glorify and exalt Thy memory, O our King, for ever. From eternity to eternity Thou art God and besides Thee we have no King, Redeemer, Helper, Deliverer, Liberator and Provider, nor one to show compassion at every time of trouble and distress. We have no King besides Thee, O God of the first and the last, God of all creatures, Master of all generations, who is praised by an abundance of eulogies, who conducts His world with grace and His creatures with compassion. The Lord neither slumbers nor sleeps, He wakes sleepers and arouses slumberers, causes the dumb to speak, frees the bound, supports the falling and straightens the bent. We give thanks to Thee alone. Were our mouth as full of song as the sea and our tongue of exultation as the roar of the waves and our lips of praise as the expanse of the sky and our eyes as radiant as the sun and the moon and our hands spread out as wide as the eagles of heaven and our feet as swift as deer, we should still be unable to thank Thee enough, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, and to bless Thy Name for even one of the many thousands and myriads of acts of kindness which Thou hast done for our fathers and ourselves. From Egypt hast Thou redeemed us, O Lord our God, and from the house of slaves hast Thou freed us. Thou hast fed us in famine and preserved us in abundance, saved us from the sword, let us escape from plague and raised us from severe and persistent illnesses. Up to now have Thy mercies aided us and Thy kindnesses not forsaken us, do not abandon us, O Lord our God, for ever. Therefore the limbs which Thou hast allotted us, the spirit and the soul which Thou hast breathed into
our nostrils, and the tongue which Thou hast placed in our mouth, shall thank, bless, praise, extol, exalt, revere, sanctify and pay homage to Thy Name, O our King. For every mouth shall thank Thee, every tongue swear to Thee, every knee bend to Thee, every upright form bow down before Thee, all hearts shall fear Thee, all inwards and kidneys shall sing to Thy Name, according to the word which is written: ‘all my limbs say, O Lord, who is like Thee’. Thou deliverest the poor from him who is stronger than he, the poor and needy from him who would rob him. Who is like Thee, who resembles Thee, who can compare with Thee, O great, strong and awe-inspiring God, Supreme God, owner of heaven and earth. Let us praise Thee, extol Thee and glorify Thee and bless Thy holy Name, as it is said: ‘By David. Let my soul praise the Lord and all my inwards His holy Name.Name.’
